docs.title: Jayden Daniels talks how he repaired relationship with Brandon Aiyuk
docs.snippet:
Daniels met with the media on Thursday and was asked about how he repaired his relationship with Aiyuk.

"I mean, I'm a grown man, he's a grown man," Daniels said. "Things happen, I don't, and you don't know what he was going through.
You don't know what I was going through at that time. So, he just sit up there. That's somebody that looked out for me when I was 18 years
old, helped me out when I first got to ASU and stuff like that. So, like I said, I kinda know the character and the person he is.
He was man enough to settle it out set our differences and kinda just move forward from there. That's, it's a brother to me.
Like I said, we've been knowing each other for some time, looked out for me, took care of me. So, kinda just put the past behind us."
